measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It proposes and conducts three human-grounded evaluation tasks to assess the quality of explanation methods for text classification models, focusing on: (1) revealing model behavior, (2) justifying model predictions, and (3) helping humans investigate uncertain predictions.
